## Syntax

Explain and comment the code.

The examples use the scored version of the simulated dataset described in [Example Data](example-data.qmd).

### Correlation table

This code runs when the site is built, so the table below it is its output.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(sjPlot)
mydata <- read.csv("data/mydata_scored.csv")
data_cor <- mydata[, c("C_total", "B_s1", "B_s2", "B_s3", "A_s1", "A_s2", "A_s3", "B_total", "A_total")]
tab_corr(data_cor,
         corr.method = "spearman",
         title = "Correlation",
         triangle = "lower",
         show.p = TRUE)
```

### Correlation heatmap

The same correlations as a heatmap. This code runs in your browser when the page loads; the first visit downloads the packages, so the plot takes a moment to appear. Change the options (for example `type = "full"` or `lab = FALSE`) and run it again.

```{webr}
#| autorun: true
library(ggcorrplot)
mydata <- read.csv("data/mydata_scored.csv")
data_cor <- mydata[, c("C_total", "B_s1", "B_s2", "B_s3",
                       "A_s1", "A_s2", "A_s3",
                       "B_total", "A_total")]
r <- cor(data_cor, method = "spearman",
         use = "complete.obs")
ggcorrplot(r, type = "lower", lab = TRUE)
```
